title: Composition of normalized strict scalar comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite coefficient fields $E,L,F$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and algebra homomorphisms $i:E\to L$, $j:L\to F$. On any scheme $W$, use the quotient sequence ring sheaves, termwise scalar extension $S_i$, and the specified associator $a_W:S_iS_j\simeq S_{j\circ i}$ induced by $c\otimes(b\otimes x)\mapsto c\,j(b)\otimes x$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Let $T$ be signed total tensor and let $\sigma$ be its unique pure-tensor-normalized scalar comparison [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]. For every $f:X\to Y$, write $P_E,P_L,P_F$ for the termwise quotient-system pullbacks and $\kappa_i:P_ES_{i,X}\simeq S_{i,Y}P_L$ for their specified scalar associations. The two successive pullback/scalar comparisons, followed by $a_Y$, equal $a_X$ followed by $\kappa_{j\circ i}$. Also the two successive scalar/tensor comparisons, followed by the tensor of $a_Y$ with itself, equal $a_Y$ on the tensor followed by $\sigma_{j\circ i}$. These are equalities of natural isomorphisms of actual integer cochain complexes of modules on the whole sequence site, retaining every quotient transition and their inverse maps. Equivalently, CompositionSquare for the displayed kappa and associator data and TensorCompositionSquare for the displayed sigma and associator data both hold. No flatness assumption on finite quotient coefficient maps is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4; composition step 7 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Transpose the pullback composition through the two successive scalar extension/restriction adjunctions and the geometric pullback/direct-image adjunction. Test the result on pullback unit sections. Naturality moves each scalar section through the first comparison. The normalized kappa formulas identify the two successive operations, and the specified scalar associator multiplies the two coefficient-one factors; ring maps preserve one, so this is the direct kappa formula. Adjunction injectivity gives the first equality.

For the tensor composition transpose through both scalar adjunctions and test on homogeneous total-tensor generators in each degree. The sigma formulas move each coefficient to the first tensor factor and insert one in the second. Naturality of total-tensor generators identifies the image under the two associators with the tensor of their values on each factor. The scalar associator formula identifies these values with the direct scalar sections, since both coefficients are one. The direct sigma formula is therefore the same value. Homogeneous generators, cochain extensionality and natural-transformation extensionality prove the tensor equality; Iso.ext retains equality of inverse maps. Both equations are in the sequence-site module category, hence include all quotient transitions. Combine the two proved equalities by conjunction.
